need to develop a habit of critically evaluating what
we see online. If you see a story that looks too
good or too bad to be true, check the source first.

Does it look real? Are there spelling errors? Does it
have other stories or just the one you read? (C)

looks reliable. (D) Websites with false information
often do not have many real stories about other
topics. (E) They also often have lots of advertisements
